def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    m = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(m, errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    g = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items() if pd.notna(k)}
